finalText:
The build now finishes with exit code 0.

Root cause: `resolveConfig` in `src\core\settings.js:17` referenced an undefined variable `retries` instead of `env.retries`, crashing at the link stage. Fixed by adding a `DEFAULT_RETRIES` constant and resolving `maxRetries` from `env.retries || DEFAULT_RETRIES`. The 3 warnings in the log (deprecated `crypto.createCipher`, unused export, circular import) are unrelated pre-existing lint notices, not build blockers — build now succeeds with "3 warnings, 0 errors."
